title: nprcgenekeepr 2.0.0.9000 (development version)
text: CRAN’s 2.0.0 submission (2026-07-17, tagged v2.0.0) accepted published 2026-07-26. Development continues top ; future CRAN resubmission ships 2.0.1, second 2.0.0 attempt. Genetic Value Analysis tab gained configurable Ranking Scheme control (issue #125): existing combined kinship/uniqueness score stays default, unchanged; new categorical priority-tier scheme now selectable alongside , adjustable high-uniqueness low-kinship cutoffs choice axis takes priority animal qualifies . reportGV() gained matching guCutoff, zScoreCutoff, axisPriority arguments scripted use, defaulting today’s behavior omitted. Breeding Group Formation tab now surfaces 5 distinct candidate groupings per run (issue #125), instead single best-scoring one, new selector switch among (comparison table candidate’s score) without re-running group-formation algorithm. Leaving selector default (best-scoring candidate) unchanged today’s behavior. groupAddAssign()’s return value gains candidates list field scripted use; existing top-level group/score/groupKin fields unchanged (alias best candidate). Breeding Group Formation tab gained Include animals control (issue #128): existing top-N cutoff stays default, unchanged; new Genetic-value floor option excludes candidate whose Genetic Value Analysis result “Low Value” instead applying fixed count, three animal-source choices. Animals labeled “Undetermined” still pass (data gap, evidence low value); animal Genetic Value Analysis result pass. Leaving control default (“Top N ranked”) reproduces today’s exact behavior. Genetic Value Analysis Summary Statistics tab’s Mean Kinship / Genome Uniqueness distribution table gained Skewness Kurtosis columns (issue #126), alongside existing Min/1st Quartile/Mean/Median/3rd Quartile/Max columns; makeGeneticSummaryTable() gained two columns script use. bias-adjusted Fisher-Pearson estimators (Joanes & Gill 1998), exposed new exported functions calcSkewness()/calcKurtosis(); either reads “N/” underlying values zero variance compute. modSummaryStatsServer() gained matching mkShape/guShape return-list reactives scripted use. Genetic Value Analysis rankings table (CSV downloads) gained flagged column (issue #127): TRUE one-unknown-parent animal reportGV()’s mean-kinship correction left uncorrected lack eligible contemporaneous breeding-age peer cohort, FALSE every animal. Previously information silently discarded; way tell animal apart one whose correction succeeded. Pedigree Browser tab gained Diagram view (issue #129, Slice 1): alongside existing sortable table, new tab renders focal-animal-trimmed population interactive pedigree diagram – sex-shaped nodes (square/dot/star/triangle), directed sire/dam edges, generation-ordered top-layout – via new visNetwork dependency. Diagrams 1,500 animals show informative message instead unbounded render; narrow focal-animal selection view one. Clicking node (issue #129, Slice 2) now re-centers population animal, re-driving focal-animal selection Table tab focal-animal text box already share – switch back Table tab (enable “Trim pedigree based focal animals”) see new selection reflected .

title: nprcgenekeepr 2.0.0 (20260708)
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-26 (breaking) qcStudbook() geneDrop() now reject id, sire, dam values containing period (offenders returned errorLst$invalidIdChars); auto-generated IDs remain period-free. (breaking) Removed unused exports getLogo(), shouldShowErrorTab(), modMinimalTestUI(), modMinimalTestServer(). Shiny application rewritten internally modular architecture; runGeneKeepR() remains primary entry point (runModularApp() works deprecated alias). (#27, #110) New Potential Parents tab listing candidate sires dams -colony animals least one unknown parent, screened estimated conception date (wiring exported getPotentialParents()); dam selection uses gestation-derived exclusion window rather fixed +/- 182.5-day window. (#48, #31) Gestation length minimum breeding ages now species-aware: bundled speciesGestation table covers 14 common colony NHP species (previously rhesus macaque), numeric rather integer breeding ages fractional minima represented exactly. getPotentialParents() Potential Parents tab derive animal’s gestation window species via new getSpeciesGestation(); Genetic Value Analysis missing-parent correction uses per-species minimum breeding ages; optional configuration-file entry (speciesOverridesPath, plus minBreedingAgeDefault gestationDefault) overrides values via new loadSpeciesOverrides(). Species absent table keep previous defaults (210-day gestation 2-year minimum breeding age), existing results unchanged. Completes issue #73. (#73) New sex-specific minimum breeding ages: qcStudbook(), checkParentAge(), runQcStudbook(), getPotentialParents() now accept minSireAge minDamAge place single minParentAge (kept deprecated alias sets ). Shiny app’s single “Minimum Parent Age” field replaced separate “Minimum Sire Age” “Minimum Dam Age” fields. (#119) New ORIP Reporting tab ONPRC colony summaries NIH Office Research Infrastructure Programs (site information, colony table founder counts, genetic-diversity metrics, CSV exports); shown ONPRC. (#47, #49) Pedigree Browser “trim based focal animals” option now includes descendants well ancestors, via new exported getDescendantPedigree(). (#35) Added exported founder helpers isFounder() getFounders(). Added exported getAutoIdFormat() setAutoIdFormat(), making auto-generated placeholder-ID format configurable (default "U%04d"). (#44, #38) Genetic Value Analysis tab parity: genome-uniqueness threshold now user control (default 4), subset filter “Export Subset” download added, default gene-drop iterations changed 1000 (matched function level: reportGV() geneDrop() now also default 1000, 5000), inert “Minimum breeding age” slider removed. Improved visualizations: educational box-plot popovers (getBoxWhiskerDescription()), plot export PNG, PDF, SVG (savePlotToFile()), enhanced age-sex pyramid (getPyramidPlot()). Genetic Value Analysis now reports three additional population-genetic summaries: gene diversity (GD = 1 - 1 / (2 * FG)) – current living breeders – sex-ratio effective population size (4 * Nm * Nf / (Nm + Nf)) variance effective population size (Crow & Kimura (1970) form), via new exported calcGeneDiversity(), calcNeSexRatio(), calcNeVariance(); defined, idealizing assumptions, -app Population Genetics Terms panel. (#118) Genetic Value Analysis now reports sampling precision animal’s genome uniqueness: new guSE column (gene-drop Monte Carlo standard error, via new calcGUSE()) “Genome Uniqueness SE (max)” summary row. new gvaConvergence() gives evidence-based advice many gene-drop iterations pedigree needs stable ranking, comparing rankings split halves one gene drop; also accepts kinshipOverrides argument. Genetic Value Analysis now corrects mean kinship animals missing one parent, previously understated relatedness let rank genetically valuable . new parentage column labels animal “known”, “one unknown parent”, “unknown”; animals parents unknown recorded origin (“Undetermined”) now ranked last, genome uniqueness reported 0 rather inflated gene-drop-founder artifact value. Animals recorded genuine imports (origin) unaffected. (Changes reported rankings genome-uniqueness numbers affected animals.) reportGV() Genetic Value Analysis tab now accept optional kinshipOverrides argument (file upload) outside-information kinship coefficients (id1, id2, kinship) replace pedigree-derived kinship named pairs ranking; applies across Genetic Value Analysis, breeding-group formation, summary-statistics tabs, summary-statistics relationship table gains overridden flag column. New exported applyKinshipOverrides(), checkKinshipOverrides(), readKinshipOverrides(); gvaConvergence() also accepts overrides. unknown-parent mean-kinship correction kept even override supplied. Leaving override reproduces previous results exactly. (#13, #95) getLkDirectRelatives() now returns full connected pedigree component (ancestors, descendants, collaterals siblings mates) instead strict ancestor/descendant lineage; new file-sourced getFileDirectRelatives() provides file pedigrees. new getFocalAnimalPedFromFile() setLabKeyDefaults() let focal-animal workflow run fully offline files, Shiny input module offers optional pedigree-file input alongside LabKey/EHR path. Fixed startup crash occurred documented-format site configuration file present, via new tolerant loadSiteConfig(). (#50) panel now shows installed package version dynamically (previously displayed hard-coded “Version 1.0.8”). geneDrop() now reports duplicate animal IDs clear error instead base-R duplicate 'row.names' allowed message. Reading file whose final line lacks trailing newline longer emits spurious “incomplete final line” warning. (#4) addGenotype() now coerces allele columns character, integer allele encoding consistent whether supplied character factor. Re-exported bundled rhesusPedigree rhesusGenotypes data sets canonical column types (character id, sire, dam Date birth exit rhesusPedigree; -character columns rhesusGenotypes), preserving every value. summarizeKinshipValues() now reports secondQuartile column lower hinge (fivenum()[2]) instead duplicating min. New dependencies: bslib, DT, ggplot2 (Imports); shinytest2 (Suggests). create_wkbk() now writes .xlsx files openxlsx instead WriteXLS, removing package’s Perl requirement (WriteXLS shelled bundled Perl script). Output behavior otherwise unchanged. Replaced magrittr pipe (%>%) base R native pipe (|>) vignettes examples; magrittr longer used. getPedMaxAge() now returns NA instead -Inf pedigree non-missing ages, age-sex pyramid plot renders cleanly instead deriving spurious -Inf axis bound. (#121) makeSimPed() now preserves known parent instead overwriting random candidate, correcting createSimKinships() cumulateSimKinships() animals one known one unknown parent. (Changes simulated-kinship values affected pedigrees.) exported makeGrpNum() renamed makeGroupNum() naming consistency sibling export makeGroupMembers(); old name kept deprecated alias. Genetic Value Analysis report CSV exports (full ranked report genetic-value subset) now include sire dam columns, showing animals unknown parent. File-based pedigree ingestion now treats species first-class column: recognized placed immediately sex canonical column order, typed character, rather surviving untyped trailing column. Pedigree Browser tab, “Clear Focal Animals” now also clears focal-animals list uploaded via file browser (displayed file name) focal Ids typed text box, neither silently re-read next “Update Focal Animals”. getPedDirectRelatives(unrelatedParents = TRUE) now returns placeholder ego record referenced parent record , instead erroring; previously dormant since caller exercised TRUE branch. (#114) offline focal-animal path longer prints benign open file ... console warning focal-id list file missing unreadable; classed error already reported unchanged. Documentation: extensive help-page dataset-documentation corrections, including genetic-value @return parameter descriptions, dataset titles descriptions, @examples getPedDirectRelatives(), cumulateSimKinships(), getIdsWithOneParent(). Documentation: example configuration file (inst/extdata/example_nprcgenekeepr_config) now documents lkPedColumns center-specific: SNPRC uses flat dam/sire columns (direct columns) ONPRC uses Id/parents/dam lookup-traversal form (curated parentage). Fixed CRAN Policy violation: Shiny application longer writes debug log file user’s home directory unconditionally startup. log file now created user explicitly enables Input tab’s “Debug ” checkbox, matching documented behavior. Fixed data-corruption bug: uploading pedigree Excel workbook via Input tab silently converted every alphanumeric sire/dam ID missing value, collapsing pedigree near--founders error warning shown user. CSV tab/comma-delimited text uploads unaffected. Fixed Breeding Groups tab’s “Custom” sex ratio option: selecting previously numeric input specify ratio silently behaved identically “None”. numeric “Custom ratio (F per M)” field now appears “Custom” selected, value used forming groups. Fixed Breeding Groups tab’s “Number top animals” field: never appeared regardless selected animal source, including default “Top ranked” selection supposed visible page load. data(examplePedigree) now includes fromCenter (colony-origin) column, derived existing origin/recordStatus fields, Potential Parents tab can show populated result (1,587 candidates) package’s example data instead graceful-degradation message.
